# OpenFilter MCP

> MCP server for the Plainsight OpenFilter platform. It exposes seven generic entity tools that cover the whole Plainsight API — entity types and schemas are discovered at runtime from the OpenAPI spec, so the tool count stays at seven no matter how many endpoints exist — plus scoped-token elicitation and optional semantic code search over the OpenFilter monorepo.

An agent connects over streamable HTTP at `http://localhost:3000/mcp` after running the
published image (`plainsightai/openfilter-mcp:latest-slim`); the README has the full
quickstart. Two things trip agents up: entity type names are lowercase with no separators
(`filterpipeline`, `pipelineinstance`, `sourceconfig`), and every API call needs a scoped
token, requested with `request_scoped_token` and approved by the user.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/PlainsightAI/openfilter-mcp/blob/main/README.md): what the server is, Docker quickstart, client configuration snippet.
- [Tools](https://github.com/PlainsightAI/openfilter-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools.md): every tool, how runtime entity discovery works, how to choose scope breadth.
- [Configuration](https://github.com/PlainsightAI/openfilter-mcp/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): authentication, environment variables, troubleshooting.
- [Development](https://github.com/PlainsightAI/openfilter-mcp/blob/main/docs/development.md): dev setup, building, testing, releasing.
